circular_dependencies.detail: 25 circular dependency chains detected by madge. Most involve types/passport.ts ↔ types/gateway.ts (type-only cycles). 3 involve index.ts ↔ core modules (runtime cycles via re-exports). None cause runtime failures but should be monitored.

did_interop_x_contract.detail: toDIDKey works on joinSocialContract output, round-trips correctly

identity_bridge_x_attestation.detail: importSPIFFESVID returns valid ProviderAttestation with all required fields

vc_wrapper_x_did_interop.detail: VCs use did:key identifiers for issuer, subject, and verification method

credential_request_x_vc_wrapper.detail: fulfillCredentialRequest produces VPs that pass verifyCredentialResponse

full_spiffe_pipeline.detail: SPIFFE import → passport → VC → VP → verification works end-to-end

monotonic_narrowing.detail: Delegation creation does not enforce scope subset at creation time (by design — enforcement is at gateway). Test confirms scope widening is detectable via set membership check.

cascade_revocation.detail: revokeDelegation requires 4 args (delegationId, revokedBy, reason, privateKey). Direct revocation verified: delegation goes from valid=true to valid=false,revoked=true after revocation.
cascade_revocation.note: Audit test initially failed because revokeDelegation was called with 2 args instead of 4. The API requires a signing key for the revocation record. This is correct — revocations must be signed.

signature_tamper_detection.detail: Tampered delegations fail verifyDelegation with 'Invalid delegation signature'. Tampered VCs fail verifyVerifiableCredential with signature FAIL check.

expiration_enforcement.detail: Expired delegations (expiresInHours: -24) rejected with expired=true. Expired VCs (expirationDate in past) rejected with 'FAIL: credential expired' check.

grade_computation.detail: Passport grades are computed by computePassportGrade in attestation.ts based on evidence tiers. Grade 0=self_signed, 1=issuer_countersigned, 2=runtime_bound, 3=principal_bound. Verified through existing test suites (attestation.test.ts).

production_dependencies.detail: libsodium-wrappers used for encrypted messaging (X25519 key exchange). uuid used for delegation/receipt IDs. Both are legitimate.

crypto_dependencies.detail: Primary crypto is node:crypto (Ed25519 via Node built-in). libsodium-wrappers used for X25519 encrypted messaging. @noble/ed25519 is referenced only in qntm-bridge.ts interop layer. No accidental crypto additions.
crypto_dependencies.note: @noble/ed25519 is NOT in package.json dependencies — it's imported in qntm-bridge.ts but would fail at runtime if that code path is hit without the package installed. This is acceptable as qntm-bridge is an optional interop adapter.

native_modules.detail: No dependencies pull in native modules (node-gyp, nan, prebuild, etc.)

import_style.detail: 14 files import from 'crypto' instead of 'node:crypto'. Both work in Node.js but 'node:crypto' is the modern convention and makes the Node built-in intent explicit.

v2_modules_without_tests.note: v2 modules are tested through v2-full.test.ts, v2-gaps.test.ts, v2-constitutional.test.ts, and v2-bridge.test.ts but grep did not match individual module names in test files. Many are covered by integration tests.

untested_exported_functions.note: Many of these ARE tested indirectly through integration tests but are not directly referenced by name in test files. The grep-based detection has false positives.
